description:
Project: build a junior astronaut mission trainer

Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer 🚀
An interactive space-learning experience where kids explore space, complete fun astronaut challenges, learn about planets and stars, and experience exciting space missions while developing curiosity and scientific thinking.
summary: This project uses MATLAB Simulink to demonstrate an AI-based butterfly simulation. It integrates an AI chip, signal processing, transmitter and receiver circuits, coils, and a battery-motor system to demonstrate intelligent signal processing and electronic communication.
